verdict.rationale: Bitbucket docs claim an AI code reviewer that reviews all code changes and suggests fixes to speed merges, which addresses the core idea of AI-driven review turnaround, but there is no evidence describing an explicit 'assign as reviewer on a PR' workflow, configurability, or independent/hands-on confirmation of this feature working. missing for 10: evidence of assigning AI as a designated PR reviewer, setup/configuration details, and independent corroboration of real-world use.
